name: Closing a Negotiation
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on closing a negotiation -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Sounds like we have an agreement -- let's put it in writing.
I'll send over the finalized terms by tomorrow.
Great, I think we've landed on something that works for everyone.
Thanks for working through this with us.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
